# pve_acme_account (Resource)

ACME account registered with a certificate authority.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_acme_account" "example" {
contact = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact` (String) Contact email addresses.

### Optional

- `directory` (String) URL of ACME CA directory endpoint. (default: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory)
- `eab_hmac_key` (String, Sensitive) HMAC key for External Account Binding.
- `eab_kid` (String) Key Identifier for External Account Binding.
- `name` (String) ACME account config file name. (default: default)
- `tos_url` (String) URL of CA TermsOfService - setting this indicates agreement.

### Read-Only

- `account` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account))
- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: name (also the `terraform import` format).
- `location` (String)
- `tos` (String)
